## Description

/billing: invoice list with state chips; detail with lines (service, code, qty, tax, amount), discount with mandatory reason, totals, events timeline. Suggested lines from the encounter (services, procedures, in-house tests) marked "suggested" for the receptionist to confirm — billing never changes clinical records. Patient banner in admin view (no clinical data). Actions per state as designed. Scope (owner, 16 Nov 2026): the core of split payments is pulled in from MDV-P4-009 (cash, card on terminal and UPI direct recorded by the desk; a Razorpay payment link for the balance, settled by "Check status"; the webhook is MDV-P4-007), and a cancel rule is added. The suggested line is the visit's consultation (its doctor, new or follow-up from the visit type), opened from the board's Billing card; procedure and test suggestions from the encounter wait for orders to carry services. Dues, advances and the events timeline stay with MDV-P4-009/011.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A draft or an issued bill with nothing paid can be cancelled with a required reason; it keeps its row and number and is never deleted.
- [ ] **AC2.** A bill can be paid in parts by cash, card on terminal (reference only, never a card number) and UPI direct; it is Partly paid until the payments cover it, then Paid; a payment beyond the balance (less a pending link) is refused; only the methods enabled in billing settings are accepted.
- [ ] **AC3.** A Razorpay link payment is Paid only when the provider shows the link paid with exactly its amount; at most one pending link per bill; the description and notes carry no clinical data.
- [ ] **AC4.** Invoice states and allowed actions match docs/03-architecture/state-machines.md#invoice-p4 (server-enforced).
- [ ] **AC5.** Discounts require a reason and are audited; issued invoices are immutable (ledger) — corrections via credit note.
- [ ] **AC6.** Billing screens never display clinical notes or diagnoses (security test on payloads).
- [ ] **AC7.** Issuing assigns the legal number from DOC_SEQUENCE.
- [ ] **AC8.** India: line items, tax and totals are exact to the paisa (integer minor units). The invoice carries a separate invoice-level "Round off" line that rounds the payable total to the nearest rupee (50 paise or more rounds up, less than 50 paise rounds down); the e-invoice `RndOffAmt` carries the same amount. Section 170 CGST rounding applies to amounts payable to the government, not to each invoice line (test: ₹1,234.50 → +₹0.50, ₹1,234.49 → −₹0.49). Sources: [CGST s.170](https://www.knowyourgst.com/gstlaw/cgst-act/170-rounding-off-of-tax-etc-170/), [GimBooks](https://www.gimbooks.com/blog/gst-invoice-round-off-differences/).
- [ ] **AC9.** UAE: invoice lines, VAT and totals are exact to the fils, with no invoice-level rounding (cash-only rounding is MDV-P4-009).
